correctness.rationale: The positively cyclically ordered boundary triple is uniquely parameterized by disk Möbius G_{z,t} with image incenter z. Its three-angle Jacobian is 6sqrt(3)(1-|z|^2)/|1+conj(z)^3 exp(3it)|^2. Dividing by the iid labelled angle density and integrating t through the Poisson kernel gives f_Z(z)=3sqrt(3)/[pi^2(1+|z|^2+|z|^4)]. Radial integration yields stated CDF and moment; the squared-radius endpoint density sqrt(3)/pi and 1-tanh^2(T/2)~4e^-T give tail coefficient. Independently checked Jacobian by numerical finite differences at four noncentral (z,t), density normalization, exact moment and large-T tail. These checks corroborate a change-of-variables proof.
